title: A day of power
summary: A city's electricity, hour by hour: drag the hand around the day.

day.sql: SELECT hour, solar, wind, hydro, gas, imports, solar + wind + hydro + gas + imports AS total FROM grid WHERE season = $season ORDER BY hour

at_hour.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT *, solar + wind + hydro + gas + imports AS total FROM grid WHERE season = $season) SELECT d.hour, solar, wind, hydro, gas, imports, total, (solar + wind + hydro) / total AS clean_share, (SELECT arg_max(hour, total) FROM d) AS peak_hour, (SELECT max(total) FROM d) AS peak_mw FROM d WHERE hour = $hour
